items.name: sidebar
items.title: DHIS2 Sidebar
items.description: Composable Tailwind navigation based on the CHAP modeling app: nested groups, footer actions and a collapsible rail.
items.docs: Wrap the layout in SidebarProvider to share collapse state between Sidebar and sibling controls via useSidebar(). Compose SidebarNavigation, SidebarContent, SidebarItems, SidebarItem and SidebarLink inside Sidebar. Add SidebarFooter and SidebarToggle explicitly. Use SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupTrigger and SidebarGroupContent for nested navigation. SidebarLink accepts render={<NavLink to="/path" />} for client-side routing; aria-current="page" selects a link. Collapse and group state can be controlled or uncontrolled.
